newsitem.title: USA: SBC says test not meeting its expectations.
newsitem.headline: SBC says test not meeting its expectations.

text.p: SBC Communications Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Edward Whitacre said Tueday the company's experiment with voice-recognition services have not met its expectations.
"It has not been as successful as I had hoped, certainly not like caller ID," Whitacre said after a speech at Washington University.

Video and data transmission could hold future potential for the company, he said in response to questions from the audience. The company also would like to expand into long-distance service and to increase the size of its international operations.
Whitacre said he thinks company is putting too many resources into wireless data transmission.
"We're spending more money on that than I would like," he said.
